newsitem.title: USA: Grand Court IPO pushed back -- underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Grand Court IPO pushed back -- underwriter.

text.p: The planned initial public offering in Grand Court Lifestyles Inc was pushed back due to market conditions, lead underwriter National Securities said on Tuesday.

The initial public offering, which was expected to price and trade on Monday, proposed to offer 1.5 million shares at a target price of $10 under the proposed symbol "GCLI" on the Nasdaq National Market. The initial number of shares proposed was 2.6 million shares.
Grand Court manages adult living communities.
